items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t think I ever played a solo in that band. But there was a fine tenor player who kind of introduced me to Lester Young... listening. I said wow, look at that.

ctx.x: I was looking through your discography. You and Danko did a scat vocal on one record, a duo record that you did in the eighties, doing “Lady Be Good” or something.
Yeah, we did Lester Young’s solo on “Lady Be Good”, but [I don’t] remember doing it on a record, wow.
When we go through your discography, probably tomorrow, we’ll just touch on little things like that and see if [they] trigger any memories.
